newsitem.title: USA: ThermoGenesis applies for CryoSeal ok.
newsitem.headline: ThermoGenesis applies for CryoSeal ok.

text.p: ThermoGenesis Corp, a maker of thermodynamic equipment for processing biological material, said Wednesday it has applied for U.S. Food and Drug Administration of its CryoSeal System.

The CryoSeal System is a device and disposable container that automates the preparation of Cryoprecipitated AHF, which is a blood component used to treat patients with blood clotting protein deficiency, the company said in a statement.
Blood bank protocols for making Cryoprecipitated require two to three days and four machines. CryoSeal can produce it in less than one hour with equal or greater yields.
